articles.title: Royal Canin Celebrates National Love Your Pet Day by Sharing 2025 Charitable Giving Efforts
articles.mainIdea: Royal Canin Celebrates National Love Your Pet Day by Sharing 2025 Charitable Giving Efforts
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Royal Canin Celebrates National Love Your Pet Day by Sharing 2025 Charitable Giving Efforts. Royal Canin, a global leader in pet health nutrition and one of the billion-dollar brands of Mars, Incorporated, is celebrating National Love Your Pet Day by announcing its charitable giving totals for 2025. Across North America, the pet nutrition brand donated more than 27.7 million meals, which fed over 1.2 million pets in need.

articles.title: Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed and Group President Rod Shurman to Participate in Fireside Chat at CONEXPO
articles.mainIdea: Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed and Group President Rod Shurman to Participate in Fireside Chat at CONEXPO
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Caterpillar CEO Joe Creed and Group President Rod Shurman to Participate in Fireside Chat at CONEXPO. Caterpillar Inc. (NYSE: CAT) Chief Executive Officer Joe Creed and Construction Industries Group President Rod Shurman are expected to participate in a fireside chat, hosted by Steve Volkmann of Jefferies, during CONEXPO in Las Vegas on Thursday, March 5 at Ceasar's Palace. Creed and Shurman are scheduled to speak beginning at approximately 8:00 a.m. PST.

articles.title: SageSure and SURE Secure $670 Million Catastrophe Bond, Largest Gateway Re Issuance to Date
articles.mainIdea: SageSure and SURE Secure $670 Million Catastrophe Bond, Largest Gateway Re Issuance to Date
articles.summary: Business Wire: SageSure and SURE Secure $670 Million Catastrophe Bond, Largest Gateway Re Issuance to Date. JERSEY CITY, N.J., February 19, 2026--SageSure, now the No. 3 global cat bond sponsor, closed with SURE a $670M Gateway Re 2026-1 cat bond, the largest yet, bringing notional to $3.1B.
